Diagnosis:
- `org.jfree.chart.plot.PiePlot3D.draw(...)` calls `initialise(g2, plotArea, this, null, info)` at line 280.
- That resolves to `org.jfree.chart.plot.PiePlot.initialise(...)`.

  - `DatasetUtilities.calculatePieDatasetTotal(plot.getDataset())`
- But `DatasetUtilities.calculatePieDatasetTotal(...)` throws `IllegalArgumentException` when `dataset == null`.

- The test creates a 3D pie chart with a `null` dataset.
- `PiePlot3D.draw(...)` does contain a null/empty dataset check, but it happens too late:
  - the check is at lines 331–338,
  - after `initialise(...)` has already been called.
- So drawing crashes before the intended "no data" rendering path can run.

- `PiePlot.initialise(...)` is not null-safe for `plot.getDataset()`.
- In the 3D draw flow, this unsafe call is reached before the caller’s null-dataset handling.

So the buggy method is:
- `org.jfree.chart.plot.PiePlot.initialise(java.awt.Graphics2D, java.awt.geom.Rectangle2D, org.jfree.chart.plot.PiePlot, java.lang.Integer, org.jfree.chart.plot.PlotRenderingInfo)`

m21.content:
The bug is confirmed.

Diagnosis:
- `org.jfree.chart.plot.PiePlot3D.draw(...)` calls `initialise(g2, plotArea, this, null, info)` at line 280.
- That resolves to `org.jfree.chart.plot.PiePlot.initialise(...)`.
- `PiePlot.initialise(...)` unconditionally executes:
  - `DatasetUtilities.calculatePieDatasetTotal(plot.getDataset())`
- But `DatasetUtilities.calculatePieDatasetTotal(...)` throws `IllegalArgumentException` when `dataset == null`.

Why the test fails:
- The test creates a 3D pie chart with a `null` dataset.
- `PiePlot3D.draw(...)` does contain a null/empty dataset check, but it happens too late:
  - the check is at lines 331–338,
  - after `initialise(...)` has already been called.
- So drawing crashes before the intended "no data" rendering path can run.

Dynamic verification evidence:
- At runtime, inside `PiePlot.initialise(...)`, `plot.getDataset()` was confirmed to be `null`.
- Stepping over the total-calculation line immediately caused control to jump to the test’s catch block, confirming the exception originates there.

Root cause:
- `PiePlot.initialise(...)` is not null-safe for `plot.getDataset()`.
- In the 3D draw flow, this unsafe call is reached before the caller’s null-dataset handling.

So the buggy method is:
- `org.jfree.chart.plot.PiePlot.initialise(java.awt.Graphics2D, java.awt.geom.Rectangle2D, org.jfree.chart.plot.PiePlot, java.lang.Integer, org.jfree.chart.plot.PlotRenderingInfo)`

READY
